claim: shadcn/ui deprecated its Radix-based Toast component in favour of Sonner.
quote: The toast component has been deprecated. Use the sonner component instead.

claim: Base UI reached stable 1.0 on 11 Dec 2025 and shipped v1.6.0 on 17 Jun 2026.
quote: 1.0.0 — December 11, 2025 — Stable. 35 unstyled UI components. Latest: v1.6.0, June 17, 2026.

claim: Zag.js toast machine provides a priority queue with max, pause on hover/focus/page-idle, screen-reader support and a promise API, framework-agnostic across React/Vue/Solid/Svelte.
quote: Priority-based queue system for ordering queued toasts. Pauses on hover, focus, or page idle. Supports screen readers. toaster.promise().

claim: Base UI Toast ships swipe-to-dismiss, hover/focus timer pause, stacking with limits, aria-live priority, F6 landmark focus and promise/update-by-id APIs; styling, animations, dismiss UI and collision boundaries are yours.
quote: Swipe-to-dismiss gestures; auto-dismiss timers with hover/focus pause; toast stacking with configurable limits; ARIA announcements via priority levels; add()/update()/close()/promise().

claim: Radix Primitives is still shipping in 2026 — a 30 Jun 2026 release fixed a Toast close-timer memory leak.
quote: June 30, 2026 — Cleared the close timer when unmounting Toast components to prevent memory leaks and errors in test environments.

claim: Radix was acquired by WorkOS and its update velocity has slowed; Base UI is now the more actively maintained primitive layer.
quote: Radix UI was acquired by WorkOS and updates have slowed for some components... Base UI (maintained by MUI) is now the more actively maintained primitive layer.

claim: React Aria Toast is still alpha and has not been prioritised for graduation.
quote: We do want to move it along, we just haven't had priority for it. I would expect that it won't be moved along before the end of the year though unfortunately.

claim: Base UI is built by the creators of Radix, Material UI and Floating UI, including Colm Tuite of Radix.
quote: From the creators of Radix, Material UI, and Floating UI, Base UI is an unstyled React component library.

claim: Customising Sonner requires nullifying default utility classes and some internal elements are unreachable under unstyled.
quote: When using unstyled=true, some internal elements are not directly reachable.
